entries.title: Psalms 98:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm.>> Sing ye unto Jehovah a new song: for he hath done wondrous things; his right hand and his holy arm hath wrought salvation for him.

entries.title: Psalms 98:2
segments: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 98:3
segments: He hath remembered his loving-kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 98:4
segments: ¶Shout aloud unto Jehovah, all the earth; break forth and shout for joy, and sing psalms.

entries.title: Psalms 98:5
segments: Sing psalms unto Jehovah with the harp: with the harp, and the voice of a song;

entries.title: Psalms 98:6
segments: With trumpets and sound of cornet, make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 98:7
segments: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein;

entries.title: Psalms 98:8
segments: Let the floods clap [their] hands; let the mountains sing for joy together,

entries.title: Psalms 98:9
segments: Before Jehovah, for he cometh to judge the earth: he will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
